source: Moomoo OpenD get_economic_calendar, market US, importance HIGH
class_rule: CPI: sum of CPI MoM + Core CPI MoM surprises, >+0.05 HOT, <-0.05 COOL; NFP: payrolls surprise >+40K HOT, <-40K COOL
caveats: A print with no consensus is unclassed (class null).
2025-12-18 carries only a YoY CPI row (shutdown-delayed Nov CPI) and is classed on YoY.
The Oct-2025 CPI was never published; no row exists for it.
